title: Lifecycle hooks in v1.31: rules that fire every time, for free
focus: How Nanocoder v1.31 introduces hooks at six lifecycle points (session-start, session-end, user-prompt-submit, pre-tool-use, post-tool-use, pre-compact), why they are the right tool for enforceable rules instead of skill subscriptions, and how pre-tool-use can veto a tool call before any approval prompt appears.
